WHAT: When brand filter (brand_ids) is dropped from cascade, brand name gets added to search text to maintain relevance
WHERE: lib/vinted-search.ts (cascade strategy builder)
HOW: Cascade builds brandQuery = brand ? `${brand} ` : ''. Strategy order:
1. 'polo shirt' + brand_ids=88 + color + catalog (all filters)
2. 'Ralph Lauren polo shirt' in text + color + catalog (brand in text, same filters)
3. 'Ralph Lauren polo shirt' + catalog (drop color)
4. 'Ralph Lauren polo shirt' (no filters)
5. 'polo shirt' + catalog (drop brand)
6. 'polo shirt' (last resort)
WHY: Without this, strategy 4 would be 'polo shirt' with zero filters — too broad, Ralph Lauren context lost entirely
GOTCHA: Strategy 2 (brand-in-text + all filters) often outperforms strategy 1 (brand filter) because Vinted's brand filter can be inconsistently tagged
